parent_objective: audit no-reset repaired materialization before reset validation design
blocked_by: M2048 materialization preflight requires audit before reset validation
supersedes: direct reset validation without materialization audit

public_gates: M2049 must audit M2048 result class and materialization guards
M2049 must check repaired specs workload quotas and claim boundaries
M2049 must decide whether reset-validation command design is admissible
M2049 must not run reset rollout measured execution or ranking
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits repaired no-reset materialization and chooses reset-validation route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: materialization audit only; no reset execution ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2048 result class is not pass
stop if repaired specs or workload quotas fail
stop if contract or claim guards fail
stop if next route is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to materialization repair if M2048 fails
route to reset-validation command design if M2048 passes
route to synthesis if reset route is ambiguous
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2048 writes repaired materialization artifacts and names M2049 as next blocker

training_stage.stage_objective: controlled routing-smoke task-quality repair materialization preflight result audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not run reset during audit
do not claim repaired panel rollout validity
allowed_updates: M2049 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for reset-validation command design or repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2049 audits materialization only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2049.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization audit fails, repair before reset or execution.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits concrete repaired panel before reset validation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether repaired panel can enter reset validation
must_synthesize_if: M2049 cannot choose reset-validation design or materialization repair
M2049 would route to another materialization tweak without new evidence

hypothesis: M2048 repaired materialization can be audited as clean enough to admit reset-validation command design.
success_criteria: M2048 result class and quotas are audited
contract and claim guards are audited
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit runs/m2048_paper_route_controlled_routing_smoke_task_quality_repair_materialization_preflight artifacts and write M2049 result audit

decision_rule: M2049 passes if it audits M2048 and selects reset-validation design or repair without overclaiming.
